dictionary.title: Client Link
dictionary.description_local: Secure pairing for the devices that talk to {assistant}
dictionary.description_node: Status of the encrypted link between this node and the server
dictionary.notice_unpaired: This node is visible on the mesh but not paired: generate a code on the server to pair it.
dictionary.notice_removed: This node is no longer paired: its token is no longer valid.
dictionary.pairing_hint: Enter the code in the device app. It lasts 10 minutes and works once.
dictionary.found_hint: These devices announce themselves but are not paired yet.
dictionary.metrics_empty: The node has not sent any measurements yet.
dictionary.unpair_hint: Revoking the pairing invalidates the node's token immediately: a new code will be needed to reconnect it.
dictionary.unpair_body: {name} will no longer be able to talk to the server until it is paired again.
dictionary.satellite_enroll_hint: For a satellite running the native agent, download a single-use enrollment file valid for 24 hours.
dictionary.request_legacy: Old link without a device key: it can only be a satellite.
dictionary.profile_satellite_hint: Limited access: audio, display, sensors and telemetry. Nothing else on this PC is used.
dictionary.profile_second_server_hint: Uses all the local resources of this PC: compute, agents, MCP tools and storage. It needs your explicit approval.
dictionary.profile_auto_hint: Becomes a second server only if the PC announces enough power and you have allowed it; otherwise stays a satellite.
dictionary.trust_allow: I explicitly allow this PC to act as a second server
dictionary.trust_allow_hint: Without this approval every profile stays a satellite.
dictionary.trust_legacy: This device uses the old link without a cryptographic identity. It stays a satellite: pair it again to unlock the second-server mode.
dictionary.trust_none: No active permissions: the device has not announced its capabilities yet.
dictionary.audit_broken: Chain broken at entry {index}: the log was altered
